0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 8th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 2nd in the West) for their third game of the season, and Phoenix is 0-1 on the road while Oklahoma City is 2-0 at home. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Oklahoma City holds the edge in recent history, winning the 2025-26 regular season series 3-2 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 131-122 win in Phoenix in the most recent meeting.
